newsitem.title: USA: Pier 1 Imports posts record second quarter.
newsitem.headline: Pier 1 Imports posts record second quarter.

text.p: Pier 1 Imports, Inc. Friday reported record second-quarter results as sales improved in the home furnishing and gift retailer's stores throughout the country.

Profits rose to a record $11.4 million, or 26 cents a share, in the quarter ended Aug. 31, from $8.9 million, or 22 cents a share, in the year-ago period. Sales jumped to an all-time high of $231 million from $199.5 million.
Same-store sales grew 10 percent over the period.
"Sales gains were positive in all areas of the country and reflected, in part, continued strength in home furnishing demand," said Clark A. Johnson, chairman and CEO.

"Pier 1 Imports' steady flow of new, fashionable merchandise provided a strong impetus for this solid sales growth. The company continues to benefit from increased store traffic as a result of its national television campaign and is enjoying increased efficiencies as a direct result of historic investments in information technology."
The Fort Worth, Texas-based company also said it will redeem around Oct. 17 all of its $17.5 million outstanding principal amount of 11.5 percent subordinated debentures due July 15, 2003.

Pier 1 Imports is North America's largest speciality retailer of imported decorative home furnishings, gifts and related items, with 706 stores in 47 states, Puerto Rico, Canada, Britain, Japan and Mexico.
Pier 1's stock fell 75 cents to $15.375 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
